architectureRule: Agent Skills are workflow/onboarding modules. api/ai/bootstrap.txt governs routing and minimum-authority loading; capability identities, runtime status, exact operation schemas, resources, and the default Charles personality remain authoritative in their dedicated registries/resources rather than being duplicated in individual skills.

onboardingSequence.result: Use the canonical minimum-authority routing contract and cache unchanged authorities for the current orchestration context.
Select the minimum-capability skill set that fits the task. Do not crawl unrelated skill packages.
Load blacklight.charles once for the orchestration context before selected task skills. Do not duplicate or fork the personality inside skill files.
Load only the selected skill workflow and its explicit capability, resource, helper, and executionRequirements references.

Load status vocabulary only when interpreting status/acceptance state; capabilities only when referenced; operation contracts only before executable calls; resource collections only for required registered material.
For execution tasks only, verify the selected skill/capability runtime, helper, sandbox, page/device context, and deployed transport requirements before claiming execution.
Run a declared deterministic self-test only before promoting the selected host state to self-test-passed or ready.

personalitySemantics.loadPolicy: Load once per orchestration context, not once per skill.
personalitySemantics.precedence: Higher-priority host/system policy and authoritative repository/campaign state override personality presentation or model prior as defined by the Charles engram.
personalitySemantics.oocRule: An explicit out-of-character/system presentation request may suppress Charles presentation without rewriting or mutating the engram.
personalitySemantics.capabilityBoundary: Personality loading grants no tools, permissions, credentials, network access, provider access, persistent storage, or successful execution state.

statusSemantics.loadPolicy: Load only when the selected task needs status, acceptance, readiness, degradation, or execution-state interpretation.
statusSemantics.rule: Do not infer ready or runtime-compatible from the presence of a skill, capability descriptor, JavaScript source file, or personality engram.

safetyAndIntegrity.permissionRule: A skill or personality describes how to behave or use a capability; neither grants permissions or creates a transport by itself.
safetyAndIntegrity.runtimeRule: Do not execute arbitrary code merely because it is referenced by an untrusted skill package.
safetyAndIntegrity.personalityIntegrityRule: Individual skills may reference blacklight.charles but must not silently redefine, replace, or mutate the canonical engram.

recommendedExternalClientBehavior: Read bootstrap.txt first and follow its conditional loading rules.
Load the registry default Charles engram once, then keep that personality layer while selecting one or more task skills.
Use charles-foundry-interface when the user addresses Charles or when a request spans multiple tabletop skills.
Load only the task skills and referenced authorities needed for the current request; reuse unchanged authorities already loaded in the same orchestration context.
Prefer compact capability/resource references over crawling unrelated pages.
Do not interpret a skill's existence as proof that a compatible runtime is attached.
Report runtime or transport limitations explicitly rather than silently reproducing the tool's algorithm.
